style: painted, posterized to ~28 levels, light grain; tileable; R1a-leaning colours. Species carry bark_type and leaf_type naming a tile; the foliage shader samples the tile and multiplies by the species colour/accent so tint still varies per individual and by genes.
notes: Patterns are stylised from real bark classes: birch (white peel, black lenticel bands), pine (orange-brown plates), oak (deep vertical furrows), beech (smooth grey, faint mottling), palm (leaf-scar rings + fibre), fibrous (shredding red-brown: cypress, redwood, juniper), smooth_grey (fig, magnolia, baobab), pink_smooth (Grandidier's baobab, gums), scaly (spruce, fir, araucaria plates), cactus (ribs + areoles), green_stem (herbs, aroids, bananas), bamboo (culm rings), mangrove (dark furrowed), peeling (eucalyptus, arbutus, plane), furry (tree fern, cycad, yucca trunks), dead (snags). Leaves: needle, broadleaf, glossy, palmate, frond, aroid (ribbed), grass, dry_grass, moss, spine, succulent, autumn, purple (the last two are seasonal/gene swaps).
